name: TailGauge
author: Arzaroth
description: Tailscale and NetBird in an Omarchy bar panel: connection state, account switching, exit nodes including Mullvad regions, networks, machine browsing with copy actions, and Taildrop sending.

barWidget.description: Toggle your VPN, switch between Tailscale and NetBird, pick an exit node or network, browse machines, and send files with Taildrop.
